title: Hearing on securing NYCHA's vacant apartments
summary: The Council's Public Housing Committee examined how NYCHA secures vacant apartments against unauthorized occupancy, following a March 2026 Department of Investigation report finding vacancies rose from about 2,840 in January 2022 to 6,740 by May 2025 with average vacancy duration around one year. The hearing reviewed weaknesses like shared master keys and lack of monthly inspections, and NYCHA's responses to DOI's recommendations for improved security and reclamation procedures. Officials, tenants and advocates were invited to testify on their experiences and proposed improvements.
